fusions.name: Folded Dart
fusions.desc: Sails a folded dart that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Inked Contract
fusions.desc: Throws an inked bolt that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Written Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Clean Copy
fusions.desc: When your stamina fills, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 15 seconds.
